cloud-service.criteria.free.en: Log in with any Cardinal account to use this.

cloud-service.criteria.subscribed.en: Log in with a subscribed Cardinal account to use this.

pdp.desc-1.en: Join the Popularity Data Pool with this media server to contribute anonymous play counts from your Music and Cinema apps.

pdp.desc-2.en: In return, your self-hosted apps receive popularity data from all Cardinal users to use in their features.

pdp.confirm-disable.desc.en: Leaving the Popularity Data Pool will disable trend data in your Music and Cinema apps.

ra.desc.en: Enable remote access for this media server to reach your self-hosted apps from anywhere.

ra.request-access.desc-p1.en: Remote Access is in Closed Beta. Once enabled, you will remain in a queue until there is room for your media server. There is a maximum of one (1) media server per user during the beta.

ra.request-access.desc-p2.en: Inactive servers may be pruned from the Closed Beta. Feel free to requeue at any time.

ra.queued.desc.en: This server is queued for Remote Access.

ra.unavailable.desc.en: This server is not approved for Remote Access yet.

ra.declined.desc.en: Cardinal declined Remote Access for this account.

ra.unknown.desc.en: Remote Access servers cannot be reached.

ra.confirm-disable.desc.en: This media server will stop being reachable from outside your network, and its remote URLs will stop working.

ra.drawer.relay.active.en: Relay will be used automatically when a direct connection is not possible.

ra.upnp.reason.port_conflict.en: No free external port on the router

ra.upnp.reason.no_gateway.en: No UPnP gateway found on this network

ra.upnp.docker-bridge-banner.en: UPnP requires host networking. Switch your compose template to enable automatic port forwarding.

ra.auth-failed.desc.en: Cardinal Cloud rejected this server's credentials. Sign in again to re-enable Remote Access.

ra.declined.detail.en: Cardinal declined Remote Access for this account. This server keeps asking on its own, but it cannot connect unless Cardinal revisits that decision.

ra.suspended.desc.en: Cardinal suspended Remote Access for this account. Signing in again will not lift it. This server keeps retrying on its own and reconnects if the suspension is lifted.

ra.vanity.desc.en: Replace the assigned address with a name of your own.

ra.vanity.invalid.en: 3 to 30 characters, using lowercase letters, numbers and dashes

ra.vanity.failed.desc.en: This address couldn't be set up. Cardinal keeps retrying on its own, and it starts working as soon as one of those attempts lands.

ra.vanity.cert-deferred.desc.en: The address is yours, but Cardinal has no certificate to spare right now. Setup finishes on its own once the budget frees up.

ra.vanity.error.invalid_name.en: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

ra.vanity.error.name_unavailable.en: That address is not available. Try another one.

ra.vanity.error.label_limit_reached.en: Your plan allows a maximum of {limit} on this server. Release an address before taking another.

ra.vanity.error.rename_cooldown.en: Custom addresses can only be changed occasionally. Try again in {wait}.

ra.vanity.error.unknown.en: That address could not be set. Try again in a moment.

ra.vanity.confirm-release.desc.en: The address stops working right away, and it stays out of circulation for a while afterwards. This server remains reachable at its assigned address.

ra.cors.desc.en: Let your own web apps at these origins call this media server remotely.

ra.cors.invalid.en: Enter a valid http:// or https:// origin without a path

ra.cors.duplicate.en: That origin is already on the list

ra.cors.confirm-delete.desc.en: Apps served from this origin will lose remote access to this media server.
